source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned change sets worker.publish-mode to Immediate instead of Manual. The fixed accepted kind retains Immediate and a literal ship phase with a note that a transform overrides it. Since the imported Gecko transform was not inspected, this establishes the declared input, not a generated shipping phase or a Microsoft Store publication result.
title: The MSIX push kind sets Immediate mode while its shipping phase can be transformed
